environment.description: Same Kubernetes cluster with Pod Security Standards enforced at namespace level via label 'pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: baseline'. The namespace also carries annotation 'pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce-version: v1.25' which evaluates against the v1.25 baseline profile. Additionally, an OPA Gatekeeper ConstraintTemplate 'K8sPSPHostFilesystem' is active with parameter 'allowedHostPaths: []' (empty list, blocking all hostPath volumes). The admission controller chain processes ValidatingWebhookConfiguration for Gatekeeper BEFORE the built-in PodSecurity admission. Container runs with default securityContext (non-privileged, no added capabilities, runAsNonRoot: true, readOnlyRootFilesystem: true). FLASK_DEBUG is set to '1' in ConfigMap but HOST_PROC_PATH defaults to '/host/proc' which maps to an emptyDir volume (not hostPath).
